newsitem.title: FRANCE: French firms see activity picking up - BoF survey.
newsitem.headline: French firms see activity picking up - BoF survey.

text.p: French companies expect activity to pick up in the coming months in all but the car sector, the Bank of France said on Monday.

The French central bank said its February survey of some 6,000 companies and business representative groups showed that company bosses still appeared cautious as far as investment plans were concerned.
"In the coming months, activity should continue to pick up in all sectors, with the exception of the automobile sector," it said in a statement on the survey.
The survey showed capacity utilisation had risen slightly, that overall demand was increasing at a modest pace and that order books were judged satisfactory, it said.
Finished product stocks were still a little larger than normal and stocks were especially considered higher than desired in agri-food and semi-finished products and in the car sector, it added.
"Company bosses continue to prove cautious on investment. There are few large-scale projects, most are for renewal or modernisation of equipment," the Bank said.
